prompt:
There are three boxes, A, B and C. Exactly one contains a prize. Each box has a label:
- Box A: "The prize is in this box."
- Box B: "The prize is not in this box."
- Box C: "The prize is not in box A."
Exactly one of the three labels is true. Which box contains the prize? End with a final line of the form "Answer: X".
